records.text: John T. Golle incorporated Education Alternatives in Minnesota and later appeared with Jeb Bush on Good Morning America to announce the Tesseract Schools project.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: came to fruition when a man named John T. ... Golle incorporated educational alternatives up in Minnesota. ... It was called Educational Alternatives Incorporated. ... John T. Golle and Jeb Bush went on to Good Morning America to announce the project the schools would come to be known as Tesseract Schools,

verification.notes: Education Week reports that Education Alternatives Inc. was formed in 1986 and later bought by John Golle, which does not support wording that he incorporated it. A Washington Post profile confirms a Good Morning America segment about the company, but current evidence did not establish that Jeb Bush appeared with Golle.

records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, I told you already that John T. Golle is the CEO of Tesseract. He does that announcement about it with Jeb Bush, who is supporting charter schools.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Contemporary education reporting identifies John T. Golle as Tesseract's founder/chairman and former CEO, but the claimed joint school announcement with Jeb Bush was not corroborated.
